formal.statement: theorem finite_extension_audit_certificate : ∀ (F K B : Type*) [Field F] [Fintype F] [Field K] [Fintype K] [Field B] [Algebra F K] [Algebra F B] [Algebra K B] [IsScalarTower F K B] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card K=Fintype.card F^Module.finrank F K ∧ ∀ W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine F, (∀ P : (W.baseChange B).Point, (pointFrobenius W)^[Module.finrank F K] P=P ↔ ∃ Q : (W.baseChange K).Point, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.map (W'
formal.scope: Every actual finite-field tower F⊆K⊆B with B any field extension, explicit compatible algebra/scalar-tower data, every general Weierstrass model WoverF: actual point PoverB comes from actual W(K) iff [K:F]iterations of actual F-Frobenius fix P. Same equivalence for every actual r-torsion set. Actual |K|=|F|^[K:F]proved, and explicit kforms derived from |K|=|F|^k. Chosen embedded finite extension, not a construction of a canonical subfield in a fixed closure. Geometric torsion rank/determinant and Weil necessity remain open for qualified BK.
